body:
CSP is used in this requirement, and yet is previously defined as Credential Service Provider. Acronym collision!! :-(  However, for this requirement, it means Content Security Policy.   CSP is used, and defined properly in requirement 14.4.3 as well.

Content Security Policy is also used, without the acronym, in requirement 1.12.2.
